name: Racer quad - missile interception (evolved guidance + PID)
notes: A ballistic missile is fired at the drone's launch pad from 450 m out at a random bearing. The Racer quad must intercept it as early and as far out as possible. The platform flies the missile ("threat") and points the target sensor at it; the script evolves a predictive guidance law plus the quad flight-controller gains (12 genes).
